text: A successful system begins with a clear understanding of requirements. Engineers identify the problem, collect relevant information, define constraints, compare possible solutions, and select an approach that can be implemented reliably and economically.
label: Paragraph

text: Modern systems depend on accurate information. Sensors collect physical measurements, controllers process those measurements, actuators perform actions, and software coordinates the overall operation. This interaction creates an integrated engineering system.
label: Paragraph

text: Testing is an important part of development. A prototype allows engineers to observe actual behavior and compare it with expected performance. Problems found during testing can be corrected before the final system is produced.
label: Paragraph

text: Documentation also plays an important role. Design decisions, component specifications, test results, operating procedures, and maintenance information should be recorded clearly so that another person can understand and reproduce the work.
label: Paragraph

text: Technology continues to develop rapidly. Engineers therefore need to combine technical knowledge with communication, teamwork, creativity, analytical thinking, and continuous learning.
label: Paragraph

text: Engineering combines scientific principles, mathematical methods, practical design, and systematic problem solving to create useful products and processes. Modern engineering projects increasingly combine mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, and communication technologies.
label: Paragraph

text: Key terms: engineering, automation, control, technology, design, analysis, testing, implementation.
label: Paragraph

text: Example: A typical engineering workflow includes problem identification, requirement analysis, system design, implementation, testing, evaluation, and improvement.
label: Paragraph

text: Notes: The information presented in this section provides general background and can be expanded according to the requirements of a particular application.
